label_en: Community hybrid / shared multi-use space (meeting place)
summary: One or a few divisible rooms that are time-shared rather than space-shared: meeting or conference room by day, associations, study circles, seniors' träffpunkt, youth activities and celebrations in the evening and at weekends. Swedish state support defines an 'allmän samlingslokal' (Förordning 2016:1367 1 §) as a premises kept open and accessible for associations' meetings, study activities, cultural activities, recreation and leisure. Regulation is generic: samlingslokal fire class (Vk 2A up to 150 persons, 2B above), hearing-aid system in samlingssalar (BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 §), accessible WC, sufficient toilets (FMH 35 §), and food rules if a kitchen serves the public. No size norm exists. Its value depends on the reversibility of the dividing element and on independent access when the rest of the building is closed.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass: 2A (max 150 persons; normal case) or 2B (more than 150). BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 11–12 §§ (samlingslokaler named). With alcohol beyond a limited extent and more than 150 persons: 2C (2 kap. 13 §). See cross_cutting.json fire_vk_2abc.

key_laws.ref: Förordning (2016:1367) om statsbidrag till allmänna samlingslokaler, 1 § (definition), 2 § (Boverket administers grants)

permits: Bygglov for change of use from office (PBL 9 kap. 15 § 1 since 2025-12-01; formerly 9 kap. 2 § första stycket 3 a; see cross_cutting.json cou_bygglov_trigger) when it becomes a samlingslokal open to the public.

Boverket grant for allmänna samlingslokaler (new build, conversion and accessibility measures) is available to non-profit owners under Förordning 2016:1367. Eligibility conditions (non-profit association, democracy condition) were not re-checked in detail.

Food served to the public on a regular basis requires registration of the food business with the municipality (EU Regulation 852/2004 art. 6 via Swedish food legislation). Occasional association use may be exempt (indicative, not verified).
Alcohol at private parties held by external renters: serveringstillstånd rules under Alkohollagen (2010:1622) depend on whether the event is closed or public (not verified).
regulatory.operator_oversight: Municipality (kultur och fritid, stadsdel, äldreomsorg for träffpunkter); non-profit owners (Folkets Hus, Bygdegårdar, Våra Gårdar); Boverket (grants); räddningstjänst; miljöförvaltning (food registration, noise)

gross_m2_per_unit.source: No Swedish law, guidance or municipal programme found that gives m2 per visitor or a standard size for a träffpunkt or medborgarhus. The 120 m2 divisible main room in data/standards/space_requirements.json (community_hybrid) is an unsourced working value.

staff_per_unit.source: Often volunteer-run or with a host (värd).

egress_design_density.source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 §: samlingslokal default 2.5 persons/m2 if the maximum is not known. In practice a fixed maximum (e.g. 'max 150 personer') is posted to stay in Vk 2A. Daytime meeting mode: 0.7 p/m2 (old BBR (repealed BBR, pre-2025) general advice 'konferensrum', practice).

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Modelling assumption (indicative, not sourced). Daytime: meetings, seniors' träffpunkt and parent groups at about 30–40 %. Evening: associations and study circles at 70–80 %. Weekend: celebrations and rentals.

required.basis: Defining space of an 'allmän samlingslokal' (Förordning 2016:1367 1 §). As a samlingssal it needs a hearing-aid sound transfer system (BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 §), and its occupant number sets the fire class (BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 11–12 §§). No size is set.

size.count: design occupants: 0.4 m2/person at the legal default (2.5 p/m2); 0.59 seated, 1.0 dining, 1.43 meeting (old BBR (repealed BBR, pre-2025) advice, practice)
size.source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 § and old BBR (repealed BBR, pre-2025) tabell 5:333 (consolidated BBR p. 52).

spaces.shareable_note: By design: office or coworking meetings by day, associations in the evening, private rentals at weekends. The fire and ventilation design must cover the peak mode, usually an evening event.
spaces.notes: Divider: movable acoustic wall. No Swedish requirement for its sound reduction was found; the Rw 45 in space_requirements.json is unsourced. For comparison, the Uppsala sports-hall curtain is required to reach at least 30 dB (sports_hall). Room height of 2,700 mm is guidance (AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 5 § allmänna råd for rooms for many persons; old BBR (repealed BBR, pre-2025) 3:3112 for publika lokaler); rooms for at most about 16 persons may be lower (old BBR (repealed BBR, pre-2025) allmänt råd). Daylight: BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 3 § for rooms where people stay more than temporarily. Floor: C1/C3 2.5–3.0 kN/m2; dancing at parties is C4 4.0 kN/m2 with dynamics (BFS 2024:6).

spaces.label_en: Small group rooms (study circles, counselling, homework help)

required.basis: Typical in medborgarhus and study association premises; not regulated.

spaces.notes: Office meeting rooms can usually be reused unchanged.

required.basis: Not required by law, but central to träffpunkt and celebration use. If used for regular food service to the public: food business registration (indicative, see permits).

size.source: No Swedish source. The 0.30 x net factor for support spaces in space_requirements.json is unsourced.

spaces.shareable_note: Can be the building's shared kitchen (see shared_amenities.shared_kitchen), or a staff kitchen during office hours.
spaces.notes: Cooker hoods and extract are easier than commercial grease ducts if the kitchen stays at 'household-type' level (assessment).

spaces.label_en: Furniture and association storage (lockable lockers per group)

required.basis: Necessary for reconfiguration and for several associations sharing one room; not regulated.

spaces.notes: Loads E1 5.0 kN/m2 for dense storage (BFS 2024:6 tabell 4:1).

required.basis: FMH 35 § (sufficient toilets); BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 7 § (at least one accessible if public WCs exist). See cross_cutting.json san_public, access_public_premises_wc.

spaces.shareable_note: Must be reachable from the main room when the rest of the building is locked.

required.basis: Practice for after-hours use (cf. IFLA 3.10.3: meeting rooms with separate access to washrooms and exterior). Accessible main entrance is law (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 1 §).

spaces.shareable_note: Can be the shared lobby if it can be zoned so evening users do not reach other tenants.
spaces.notes: Ground floor with a street entrance is the strongest enabler. Escape routes must remain usable when other zones are locked: escape doors must open without delay with a lever or push (BFS 2024:7 7 kap. 34 §; a fixed thumb-turn is allowed for fire compartments of at most 50 persons), allow return after passage unless they lead to a safe place (7 kap. 35 §), and doors that may be locked must be interlocked against an essential function of the room (7 kap. 37 §). See shared_amenities shared_entrance_lobby for the zoning of a shared lobby.

variants.label: Seniors' träffpunkt (municipal)
variants.changes: Daytime profile, meals and coffee, accessibility emphasis (rollators, hearing). Kitchen central. Often co-located with a library or care services.

variants.label: Medborgarhus / Folkets hus
variants.changes: Larger: several rooms plus an event hall (see assembly_event), often with library and café. Eligible for Boverket grants (non-profit owners).

variants.label: Office meeting suite by day, community by evening
variants.changes: Booking and access control are critical. Furniture swaps are minimal if the room is fitted for both uses.

typical_blockers: Fire class change Vk 1 to 2A: 30 m travel distance; above 150 persons 2B with alarms (cross_cutting fire_vk_2abc).
Peak ventilation in evening events with office AHUs scheduled and sized for daytime office density.
After-hours zoning: independent access to WC and exits without opening the whole building.
Noise from evening activities to dwellings, if the building is mixed (BFS 2024:10 tabell 2:1, 56 dB minimum).
typical_enablers: Ground-floor office units with a street door convert easily.
Existing conference suites with pantries and WC cores fit almost directly.
Up to 150 persons (2A) avoids fire alarm and evacuation alarm requirements.
Boverket grants for allmänna samlingslokaler (non-profit owners).

sources.ref: Förordning (2016:1367) om statsbidrag till allmänna samlingslokaler, 1–2 §§ (definition stable across consolidations 2018–2022 per lagen.nu)
BFS 2024:7 (original text, PDF): 7 kap. 34, 35, 37 §§ (escape-door hardware, return after passage, interlocking of lockable doors)
Old BBR (repealed BBR, pre-2025) tabell 5:333 and 3:3112 allmänt råd (consolidated BBR pp. 26, 52)
IFLA Public Library Service Guidelines 2010, 3.10.3 (p. 59), meeting rooms with separate access

open_questions: No municipal funktionsprogram for träffpunkt or medborgarhus was found online (searched generally). Try specific cities (Stockholm äldreförvaltningen 'träffpunkter', Göteborg 'mötesplatser', Malmö) for a space list with m2.
Current consolidated text of Förordning 2016:1367 (amended by SFS 2025:390) not re-checked; the definition in 1 § is assumed unchanged.
Food-registration exemption for occasional association use is not verified against Livsmedelsverket guidance.
Sound reduction requirement for movable dividing walls has no Swedish legal source found; SS 25268 (removed from Boverket's rules) may still be used in practice.

Bicycle parking: BFS 2026:4 (from 2026-07-01) applies on change of use only in the ombyggnad cases in 1 kap. 4 §; the count for a community room inside a mixed building is set by the building as a whole (see shared_amenities shared_bicycle_room). Confirm the municipal parking norm for the pilot.
BFS 2025:10 amendments to BFS 2024:7 (from 2025-12-01) were not checked for 2 kap. 11–13 §§ and 7 kap. 34–37 §§.
